mechanism: over-ground velocity of a mature track may move away from its 3 s EMA reference by at most +4 / -6 m/s^2; moves back toward the reference pass unchanged
provenance: open-loop openpilot 10b9e73 card/radard/planner replay of the public decoder with and without the option; model and ego stay logged
prior_use: all drives have prior use; owner drives D1/D2 motivated the option; the away-only form was chosen after a first round in which an up-limit alone lengthened one held-out false-brake episode

definitions.radar_only_episodes: human-controlled, radar <= -1 for >= 0.3 s while vision >= -0.3
definitions.targeted_episodes: contiguous moving ticks, radar <= -1 for >= 0.3 s while vision >= -0.3

event_example.description: curve braking event; targeted check, selected example
